llm_response.reason: The website is hosted on an educational institution subdomain yet displays content unrelated to its supposed purpose, primarily promoting online gambling (WINSORTOTO), lottery services, and fake e-commerce sales with unrealistic discounts and claims of easy wins. The website mimics branding from legitimate businesses like Lazada and urges users to download apps, a common scam tactic. There is no trace of legitimate contact or business details, and multiple scam characteristics (spoofed brand, urgency tactics, fake celebrity/testimonial emulation, unusual product range, etc.) are present.
